chapters.label: Naples, 2023
chapters.text: Naples, 2023. Napoli against Juventus. Kvaratskhelia sends in a cross. Victor Osimhen leaps high... Goal! His second header of the night!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Osimhen runs at the ball. He plants one foot, swings the other knee up, and flies up to meet it.

chapters.label: Head it down
chapters.text: From behind the goal, watch his head snap forward. He heads it down, hard, into the middle of the net. Four–one Napoli!

chapters.label: Jump off one foot
chapters.text: Jump off one foot to go higher. Drive your knee up, get above the ball, and nod it down toward goal!
